rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday term for chewing gum in Hong Kong Cantonese.

example.english: After eating garlic, chew some chewing gum before going back to work.
example.traditional: 食完蒜頭，食粒香口膠先好返工。
example.jyutping: sik6 jyun4 syun3 tau4 sik6 nap1 hoeng1 hau2 gaau1 sin1 hou2 faan1 gung1
